dedupe_keys.name: discharge simulations for the seine river catchment scenarios to analyse the future of low flows and reservoir management

description: The STARS4Water project publishes GRSD model discharge simulations for the Seine catchment under four contrasting climate cases and nine strategies for four reservoirs. Zenodo says the semi-distributed model covers 155 stations; reservoir-management variants are available only for 17 downstream stations affected by the reservoirs. A public 199 MB ZIP holds the output under CC BY 4.0. Water-allocation and reservoir-operation simulations could compare low-flow outcomes across the management cases or use the series as a scenario benchmark. These are projected model results, not a complete set of observed station records. The page gives no file-level time step, station mapping, units or scenario codes. The archive was not opened and its contents were not run, so those details remain unverified. A related Seine ecological-risk deposit derives environmental-flow classes from these discharge scenarios; it is a different resource. No catalogue record explicitly identifies this output archive.
